reviews.text: Everyone was extremely kind and supportive. Also, they gave me an itemized estimate of costs right away — no surprise charges. Going to the emergency vet is never a fun experience but their kindness and professionalism made it so much better.

I brought Theodore aka Teddy in for a cut eyelid that looked infected.  Teddy is ALWAYS excited to go the vet. Lol
The techs were VERY nice and Teddy enjoyed the rubs. 2 doctors stopped by to just see him because I literally have the sweetest Bullmastiff in the world.
Teddy is recovering nicely with antibiotics, pain meds and artificial tears.
Thank you so much VEG

My dog Bella had a great experience with VEG after being hit by a car. The staff took our concerns seriously and the doctor was very empathetic to our needs. I would highly recommend service there to anyone who has an emergency with their pets.

My 20 year old cat was straining to pee and we wiped up some blood so we didn't want to take any chances. We took her in and they saw her almost immediately. Vet techs were super nice and everyone at the ER was super nice despite it being a busy night for them. They answered all the questions we had and gave us a very comprehensive breakdown of what services we would need to do.

I cannot express enough gratitude for the team at VEG ER.  I came in with my 100 lb Rottweiler, with a swollen eye - you can imagine we were not the easiest case of the day.  From intake to leaving, the whole team was kind, empathetic and incredibly supportive in helping my guy find some relief.  We worked with Dr. Widenbaum and Denaris, who were incredible.  Each was overwhelmingly patient with my dog, being understanding of his discomfort and the nature of his breed, which makes me deeply grateful. They had to move very slowly with us, but never once did we feel like we were holding up their day, keeping an exam room too long or like we were too difficult of a case.  Instead, they walked us through an exam plan, all of the options at hand and provided their best suggestions for treatment.  My pup and I aren't out of the woods yet, but VEG ER really helped get us through the week until our normal vet can see us.

During our 4 hour stay at VEG ER, we were in very close proximity to the rest of the team.  The entire time, you could tell what a united team works here - everyone clearly has positive energy and excellent intent with their work.

While I hope to not have to see others at the emergency vet, I would not hesitate to recommend anyone in bringing his/her pet here.  Thank you again to Denaris and Dr. Widenbaum - they really saved the day for my dog and me.
This was the best vet experience ive had. Fully competent and vibrantly dedicated staff working to help animals and their humans get the care they need. Thank you from Naya and Beyond. ❤️
Phenomenal staff genuinely amazing, they will handle the care of your pet very swiftly and with compassion
Thank you to all the staff at VEG for helping and guiding us through a difficult decision with a stray cat we found. Truly appreciate your kindness, professionalism, and honesty
I honestly felt like family coming in here. I’ve never experience so much warmth and compassion from a vet the way they did! I highly recommend!!!!!

Staff was kind.. however my dog didn’t receive the proper care he deserved. They had me holding my dog most of the visit, poke him twice, gave him a pinch a IV n charged me for the full bag n 1500. My dog had a heart murmur.. but told me he was perfectly fine n injected some marijuana. Which I thought was strange.. I believe I was profiled… based on stereotypes.. Wouldn’t recommend. Glad I got another opinion. My dog had a failing heart n they sent us away. W a big bill
The whole staff was amazing. I will always be grateful for their patience and attentiveness with my fur baby who’s a senior dog ❤️
Dr. Fink and Phynix were absolutely amazing!  So helpful,caring and supportive throughout!

This place is truly full of compassion and love. We brought my mom’s dog, Diamond, here after she was attacked by a dog nearly 10 times her size. During such a heartbreaking and difficult time, it meant so much to us to be surrounded by such compassionate and empathetic staff who genuinely cared.

We can’t thank you enough for everything you did to make Diamond comfortable during her final moments. We are so grateful for your care, compassion, and every effort you made to save her. Knowing she was surrounded by people who cared meant more to our family than words can express. ❤️💕
I took my dog for check up, process was fast and it was worth it, thanks to the team that took care of my mini daschund

Thank you so much to the staff and doctor who saw our little old man Biggie. Thank you for been so loving,kind and understanding, and for been blunt and honest about his health. Yesterday we made the decision to put our Biggie down due to his health been in such a bad state. All the staff the minute we walked in were so sweet and nice. The doctor was amazing i hate i can't remember his name he spoke to us with such a sweet and caring tone made us feel so good in such a hard time. I highly recommend this vet clinic our experience was really amazing. Thank you so much!!! 🙏🙏

Brought a kitten in who seemed lethargic. Staff was very cold and standoffish. They didn’t explain anything or offer any explanations for any of the steps they took for treatment. Wanted to charge us 1200 but had no clue what was going on with the kitten. When we hesitated they jumped to euthanasia as an option. Seems like a money grab and when you can’t pay the exorbitant costs or go along with them they jump to putting your pet down. No empathy or passion just looking for the money. This is the second interaction that has gone this way. We took another pet to a different location and had the same experience. We took the kitten to another vet and it’s already showing signs of improvement. Stay away!

I cannot thank the team at Veg ER for pets Hospital enough for the incredible kindness, compassion, and dignity they showed to my beloved Chihuahua, Tiny, during her final moments. Tiny was 17 years old and had been my loyal protector for nearly two decades.Tiny always disliked the vet and was famously feisty during appointments, but I always made sure she felt safe with me. When it was finally time for us to depart and for her to transition to peace, the staff at Veg ER made a heartbreaking day go as smoothly as possible.What meant the most to me was how they constantly used Tiny’s name. They made everything about her and her comfort. Because of their beautiful, pleasant, and attentive service, I felt completely comfortable leaving Tiny in their hands. They helped give her a peaceful release, and they gave me the comfort of knowing she was treated with the highest level of respect. I highly recommend Veg ER to anyone facing these difficult moments. Thank you for taking such wonderful care of my sweet girl.

Highly recommend this ER for pets. The staff is amazing. I took my pooch in for a cut in her paw. They took care of my Reyna girl so well. I’m so grateful for Dr.Finks and his amazing techs Melissa and Victoria. I was so nervous and anxious the whole time and they explain everything that was going to be done. Thank you !thank you! thank you! For making my experience go smooth even tho I was soo anxious. So grateful for this amazing team. God bless them always!!! they have a very kind heart when it comes to pets. 🙏🏼🙏🏼🙏🏼 I appreciate everyone in the clinic. Thank you Dr Finks and team.

The staff was more than helpful I would like to thank them a lot for all their help and support my kitten was really sick the vet that assisted him was super kind and explained everything to me. If it wasn’t for them and being super kind and super helpful and caring I wouldn’t have known what to do they took in my kitten right away and helped him as best as anyone could’ve possibly done. They calmed me down and helped me and reassured me through the phone told me they would help nothing felt pressured and answered all my questions without me having to even ask, they helped me and my kitten a lot I will always be thankful for this location and the staff for doing what they would for my kitten
Top rate experience, would return and recommend! Presidential status!
They took 20 minutes to respond and my kitten was in danger and dying
Dr. Phillips addressed all my concerns and very understanding  and caring . I wish he was Guapo’s  regular veterinarian.

Dr. Pereira and the staff at VEG Southloop were incredibly kind and efficient. We were visiting from out of town and forgot our cat's travel meds. They were extremely helpful and we were able to have a safe journey home because of them.
They were super fast and efficient. I felt like I was in good hands the whole time.
I took my dog ​​home, and he was the same or worse after the visit. They did nothing for my dog. And it was extremely expensive.
They delete comments that describe them as providing poor service.

Mr. Baby and I are so thankful for the angels at VEG! He was seen as soon as we walked in and helped in such a compassionate and professional manner. I felt secure with the information and treatment plan I was given and they even made accommodations for me to be able to afford getting Mr. Baby treated. Thank you! I can't remember the names of the two nurses that took care of Mr. Baby, but many thanks go out to them and Dr. Fink. Mr. Baby is doing much better and on the road to recovery.

Overall the experience was beyond exceptional, took care of my muscles(cat) made him so comfortable, I will forever be grateful. First time he got sick and the dr gave me so much clarity of what to do and how to help him.
Everyone in this hospital from the person that checks you in to the dr and all the staff are wonderful,
From the bottom of my heart and muscles, Thank you so much.

I didn't see any humanity or empathy. If you don’t have insurance even if you’re willing to pay they won’t treat your animal. If they see that it’s not a purebred (a stray cat), they send you to the animal care and control, without considering how much time the animal has left to live; they don’t even examine it, using the excuse that it has a microchip. even if it did have one a sick animal should be stabilized first, and only then should the legal paperwork be handled or the supposed owner be sought out. Thanks for nothing the cat die.

We recently had our sweet Roux hospitalized here at VEG South Loop, and I cannot express enough how grateful we are for everyone here! All the staff were extremely kind, responsive, and trustworthy. The front desk staff were very nice and reliable with communicating with the people in the waiting room and coordinating with those in the back. The nurses were so patient and attentive to Roux while they worked with her, even though they had plenty of patients to juggle. Not only were they very attentive to the animals, but to the owners and families as well. Everyone was very skilled and worked so well with our cat to complete what they needed with her while minimizing her stress and still allowing us to stay right by her side. We really appreciated nurse Rachel, who helped our cat in triage and as she was being admitted.
The doctors were incredible as well—Roux was seen by Drs. Cohen and Grossman. Again, I could see that the ER was full of  patients to care for whenever I visited, but they were committed to answering all of our questions and explaining what we could expect based on evidence/their experience. Dr. Grossman was with our cat for her last day at the hospital before coming home, and it was so clear how much care and compassion he has for the pets and their families. We were so touched to know that someone so caring was looking after Roux!
If you are a pet owner in the area, VEG South Loop is a great place to keep in mind in case you and your pet encounter an emergency.
We've been to VEG ER a handful of times now for our dog, Baby, and each time the staff have been wonderful and so accomodating. Would highly recommend!

I genuinely cannot thank everyone enough for how they took care of my Canelo. I came into the ER a complete wreck and so scared for him. It didn’t even take five seconds until I was seen. Everyone on the night shift was incredibly kind and understanding with me. I don’t know who it was, but I even bumped into someone as I was crying my eyes out. I remember apologizing and someone told me not to worry because it was naturally an emotional space. From then on, I felt extremely understood. Everyone was always transparent about what was going on, and even invited me to be hands on with the procedures my cat was going through. I genuinely cannot thank everyone that took even the smallest role in my Canelo’s care enough. They were always transparent about what was going on, explained what they were doing, answered all of my questions, and did everything they could to help both Canelo and me through a really scary situation.

I especially want to mention Juan, who was taking care of the cats every-time I went over. He was so attentive to our baby and provided such a gentle calm space for the entire cat ward to heal. He had such a calming presence and made me and my brother feel so much better about leaving our cat there overnight. He had calming music playing for the cats and just seemed to make his priority be to make them feel as peaceful and comfortable as possible, which I appreciated so much because I can only imagine how anxious they must already be being away from home and in an unfamiliar place.

What truly stuck with me and made me feel so safe was after discharge. When I had to bring my cat back after he was already home , there were staff members I had never even met who already knew who Canelo was and were immediately willing to help him. I even heard someone say “He’s so cute I love him so much” 😭 It might sound like such a small thing, but as his owner it meant SO much to me. It made me feel like he wasn’t just another animal they were treating. They actually knew him and cared about him.

I’ve honestly never felt that kind of connection with the staff at his regular vet, so this experience really stood out to me. Of course I hope I never have a reason to bring either of my cats to an emergency vet again. But if I ever do, I know exactly where I’m going and who I’m recommending to anyone who needs it.
All about profits here, they don’t care about your animals health.

I want to express my displeasure about this place I arrived at 6:20am because my dog was vomiting all night an emergency but they never attended to me until 9:05am I had to leave the site to look for a better one
I have always had a positive experience during difficult times when I have visited VEG in the south loop.  Really have good people helping to care for your animal at this location.
Great staff!! They are very supportive and helpful!!!!

I am mixed on this location as VEG has always been a great resource for my family when an emergency has come up and earlier in the year I had brought my dog in for what we thought might be UTIs as she had a history of getting them randomly and would be treated with antibiotics and pain medication. Unfortunately during our visits in January and March, several expensive tests were run, bloodwork, urinalysis, and xrays as well as ultrasounds and while no infection could be confirmed we were still treated for UTIs. Recently, we found a new vet and took my dog in for again what we thought were UTIs that wouldn't clear. Unfortunately my dog passed away a week ago and her new vet is amazing and still passed along her urinalysis results. Bladder cancer.

The lab who ran her urinalysis saw abnormal cells and further investigated to find that she had bladder cancer. I am frustrated that one week of being at a new vet at a fraction of the cost gave us answers that came too late when we paid for essentially more testing at VEG without any further investigation from their team beyond them not being able to find what was wrong.

I am sad that I lost my best friend but I am also sad that for all the money that they are paid, the labs that we done and the results given clearly didn't really investigate beyond the single problem they thought it could be and it hurts knowing my pup was probably in incredible pain for months without fully understanding what the issue is. If I am told it is a UTI I have no way of knowing more beyond that. Again, another vet with another lab that was way cheaper saw abnormal cells and decided to investigate (without any further costs) and were able to determine that the issue was cancer but at VEG the issue just stopped after finding that she didn't have a UTI but deciding to still treat it as a probably UTI even though bladder cancer symptoms can mirror UTIs.

It's a place you never want to go as a pet owner. I found myself there one morning two weeks ago when my 18-year-old cat woke up having difficulty breathing and just wasn't himself.

Sadly, I had to return the next day and made the incredibly difficult decision to let him go. Throughout both heartbreaking visits, I was treated with such kindness by the entire staff.

I especially want to recognize how wonderful Dr. Goins was. She showed me such incredible compassion and care during one of the most heartbreaking experiences I've ever been through. I will always be grateful for the kindness she showed both my cat and me during such a difficult time.

Thank you to the entire team for making an unbearable experience a little less painful.
Dr. Dustin Fink did an amazing job caring for my French bulldog Gia. I couldn’t have asked for a better doctor. I highly recommend VEG as they let you stay with your pet throughout their care.
fantastic experience and excellent staff

The Veg team saved the lives of my rescue kittens, and I can't thank them enough. I suddenly rescued kittens over the weekend, and when one started to vomit and stopped eating the first night I had her, I was not only able to call the Veg team at 5:00am and speak to a vet, who provided very helpful guidance on next steps, but was also able to bring them in and get them incredible supportive care, create a plan for follow-up, and even get supplies and guidance on their basic care given their ages. The kittens bounced back incredibly well after the care they received, and all of the Veg team members were wonderful to work with.
Today taking my dog to the VEG team was a good decision and we were both very pleased with the service and attention. Thank you!❤️
Hi Nubia, Thank you for your 5-star rating! +Carra

Today I had to take my Uno to the vet, and Dr. Brett Grossman at VEG took great care of him. He was very attentive to both Uno and me. The nurse who took his vitals and temperature was also extremely caring and attentive. This was my first time here, and if I ever have to come back, I will definitely always pick them. If you can’t afford their services, they will definitely work with you and are extremely understanding of your financial situation.

Do not bring your cat here! We brought in a 17 weeks old cat that we found on the streets and we cared for him for 8 days. Suddenly he became lethargic and started drooling. We were trying to do the right thing and get the little guy some care. We informed the vet of the circumstances and the fact that I'm an unpaid teacher on summer break. I just didn't want the little guy to suffer. First test they performed was for feline distemper. The test came out negative. Soon after this the vet recommended further testing. We explained our financial situation and how 1200 vet bill with no treatment was hard for us to do. She the recommended we just euthanize since we didn't have the means to provide the care and we didn't know what was wrong. We then agreed to take on the bill in hopes this little guy could get better and the lab work and $600 x-ray would give us answers since his feline distemper was negative. The bloodwork came back with low white blood cell count. So the doctor ordered another feline distemper test, this time it came back positive. The first test was done with only a fecal sample while the second test was done with a throat and fecal swab. In the end the cat needed to be put down because we could not afford 6k to get him intensive treatment.  Which then I was charged an additional 500 for euthanasia and cremation. A total of 1700 spent and 5 hours, yet no help for the little guy. They never once gave him IV fluids or pain medication. This place is a scam, the first test they ran was done improperly. He exhibited every sign of feline distemper. Yet they pushed for more testing or euthanasia from the beginning. I asked for medicine to make him more comfortable until the morning so I could take him to CACC and they bullied me telling me that it was inhumane to make him live to the morning and he was gonna die at home anyway. All this to charge me an additional $500 to euthanize him. This place does not care about animals just lining their pockets.

This post might be a bit lengthy, so bear with me.

A few nights ago, we had to take our baby girl of 10+ years to VEG. She is very anxious at the vet, but the staff took their time with her and put us in a room so she would not be under duress. Diana and Natasha were our nurses, and they both provided excellent care to my girl and me. Additionally though, I want to specifically draw attention to Dr. Alison Dygert.

Dr. Dygert is exactly what I would hope to see in a veterinarian at any stage. She is palpably passionate about patient care, she breaks down the complex terminology (which I needed), and she is one of the most compassionate professionals I have ever met in a medical profession, and I myself am a medical professional. One thing I think I will always remember about this impossible night was when we got our results back; she was taking her time to explain the spread of a cancer that had been brewing for months, and we did not know what was happening. I interrupted her and asked her through tears, "I am sorry to interrupt, but are you telling me there is nothing I can do to save my girl?" She told me that unfortunately, anything we would do other than say goodbye to her would be putting her through immense pain only to extend her life a few short months. However, when she did so, I could tell she was hurting with me. Though I understand numbness likely happens over time, her ability to care enough to make me feel like my baby girl wasn't just a number meant the world to me.

If Dr. Dygert ever opens her own practice, I hope to be first in line to have her taking care of the health of my fur family.

Best wishes to Dr. Dygert, the staff, and this facility. Truly one of a kind.
Hi John, Thank you for your 5-star rating! +Carra

This review is six months overdue but it is difficult to write.  Our beloved sixteen-year-old chihuahua had a bad accident in February and I brought her in a taxi to the VEG ER in the South Loop.  The staff there was wonderful in caring for her.  They did everything with such obvious compassion and concern.  Unfortunately her condition declined and the next morning they advised that we transfer her to MedVet on the North Side because of their comprehensive critical car facilities.  They transported her there for me free of charge so I was able to go directly there.  The staff at MedVet advised us to let her go, so we did.  I am very grateful to everybody at VEG ER for everything they did to assist Coco, and I think you can be confident your pet will receive the same care.
Absolutely awesome,  caring service. My dog loved the staff!  Best vet service I've ever been to including Bellas personal vet!! Thank you Becky Lundgren and staff!!!!!!!

I called VEG ER for pets, before coming because all three of my cats have been sick after coming from a shelter. I specifically asked if they offered a sliding scale, payment plan, or financial assistance because I simply cannot afford a large emergency vet bill. The person I spoke with made it sound like there were options available and even told me to bring all three cats. I registered one over the phone and was told the other two could be registered when I arrived.

My son, daughter and I walked for an hour pulling our three cats in a wagon because we believed this was a place that could help.

Unfortunately, our experience was very disappointing. When we arrived, the doctor, who was also the person at the front desk, seemed annoyed that we were there. During intake, as I was trying to explain where the cats had come from and all of their symptoms, I was interrupted and told, "Can you give me the shorter version?" That made me feel dismissed, especially since I was trying to provide important medical information.

The doctor focused almost immediately on the cost, explaining that it would be hundreds of dollars just for exams and potentially thousands more for treatment, and that payment was required at the time of service. I was then given applications for credit programs, even though I had already explained that my low credit was the reason I had called asking about financial assistance in the first place. I did not qualify for any of the financing options.

The bright spot in our visit was the veterinary nurses. They were kind, gentle, compassionate, and treated our cats with genuine care while checking their temperatures, pulses, and mouths. They were the only part of the experience that made us feel welcome.

I completely understand that veterinary care is expensive and that costs need to be explained. However, the way the information was presented lacked compassion, especially after we had called ahead and made the difficult trip there with sick animals. I hope this clinic can improve how they communicate with families who are already scared and worried about their pets.

I hope this feedback helps improve communication with future clients who are already under tremendous stress trying to help their pets.

A couple of months ago, we had to rush our dog, Acadia, here after we thought she had ingested rat poison. They got her back within minutes and started treatment immediately. Their quick actions more than likely saved her life. The doctors and staff were incredibly caring, compassionate, and kept us informed every step of the way during such a stressful time. We are so grateful for the amazing care they gave Acadia. Thank you all so much!
Hi Brijit, Thank you for your 5-star rating! +Carra

Dr. Goin was superb. She was incredibly personable and made a genuine effort to care for my dog. After I shared my financial concerns and explained that I had already made contact with the University veterinary hospital, she told me she had a friend who was a student there and immediately reached out in an effort to help expedite an appointment. She went above and beyond to explain my cardiology options and genuinely wanted to help.

I am truly grateful, and under the circumstances, I'm so thankful she was the veterinarian who treated my dog. Her level of compassion, professionalism, and customer service is something that is rarely seen today. She made an incredibly stressful situation much easier to navigate, and I can't thank her enough.

Bravo, Dr. Goin, and thank you for providing exceptional care to both my dog and me.
Hi Andy, Thank you for your 5-star rating!
Banc was a sarcastic veterinarian and I wouldn’t recommend for a concerned person. Transparent prices. $200 for visit alone. The cost of other tasks were cheaper than visit alone.
My dog is saved, beautiful people.
Thank you dr brett grossman , i really appreciated , cherry doing better and walking now

My puppy had an allergic reaction this morning that caused his face to swell pretty good. We came in right away and everyone on staff was great! They made sure I had all of my questions answered and Cricket was comfortable the whole time.

Beyond blessed I took my baby girl Rossie to this vet! I honestly don’t know what would’ve happened with her if I would’ve not taken her on time! Rossie got there with her heart beat extremely low close to almost passing away! I was fortunate for the whole team to take care of my baby girl she was never left alone. They did everything to help her and we were lucky and blessed she made it through! My babies heart went from 40 to 120 🥺♥️🙏 although treatment is extremely expensive I am happy my baby survived and was Diagnosed with Addison disease. I will forever be thankful it’s like they brought my baby back to life.

Thank you, Dr. Grossman, for being so kind and taking the time to talk me through what to do for my cat who was stung by a wasp. I was very upset and worried, but your kindness, calm demeanor, and knowledge really helped reassure me and made me feel confident that everything would be okay with my kitty. She’s feeling much better now, and I can’t thank you and your staff enough for being so helpful.

Hopefully I won’t have any future emergencies, but if I do, VEG will be my first choice again. Thank you!

Major shout out to the good people/professionals at VEG South Loop. Last week, I was there to put my Joey to sleep after she gave me a wonderful 19 years. Once they found out why I was there, staff ushered us into a private room right away, even though the ER was packed. They were accommodating, kind, efficient...they cradled my deceased dog like a baby as they took her away from me to prepare her for aftercare....we had been there before - ingestion of corn cobs, ingestion of a yoga mat, ingestion of a sponge...then she was attacked by a pit bull last fall. The team at VEG were nothing but angelic and knowledgeable and comforting each visit. While it's never a pleasure to bring your furry baby to an ER, they somehow make it a pleasure and I will miss them. Thank you, VEG South Loop, for taking such good care of my crazy little doggie baby...and her anxiety-filled mom!
Dr.E was the bomb! Rebecca who was at the front desk was warm and caring. All the technicians were reliable and ontop of things. Very professional. We would recommend them to future customers

Everyone is friendly willing to explain what's going on helping you with your dog's care.Their understanding in all financial situations and it was a great thing.They helped me save my dog's life.I will forever be grateful with them.

I want to leave a review for the amazing godsend team at the veg ER for pets staff. Thank you so much for giving me and my pet such great attentive care. I came in with a scare of toxic poison from garlic for my pet. The team acted immediately to calm me and make sure that my pet had the best care possible, but I really want to give a huge shout out to the front receptionist Jada for her calm, reassuring therapeutic conversation, Jada. Your conversation was so calming and relaxing, and great that I almost forgot why I was there. Thank you so much for being a great pet therapist. I pray all pet parents receive the same treatment from the staff at veg ER for pets that I received I give this review as a huge thank you!
Quick and compassionate care
Great caring staff. Explained everything to us and made it very comfortable for our final moments with our cat. Grateful we found them. Would recommend.

First experience was great, second was not. I came for an xray and the doctor came over after triage to say itll be 3 to 4hrs to be seen. He wouldn't even put in the xray because they were going to prep 2 other pets for surgery soon. I called 15minutes before arrival and they refused to provide an estimate of wait. It was only after triage they say the wait time. I mentioned the pet was stable. The staff takes a few minutes to  before they come to take your pet for a scan. then results take about 1hr to receive. Instead of wasting 3hrs of time, they would of had me out the door sooner. No wonder their er is always busy. They manage it poorly. They waste so much time. rather then filling out orders for what the patient came in. They have you wait. Just ridiculous how even with pets they spend about 10 minutes per patient, but a lot less sanitary conditions. Less hand washing, more cross contamination. They triage wherever they feel like it and have you go in and out of the shared er room for 2min conversations that dont make much progress.  No such thing as privacy here either. Pets coming in, staff chatting about patients reason of visit outloud..etc. a dog crapped diarrhea in the wait room and the staff wiped it off with a tissue. There was no sanitation. It was gross and poorly managed.

I took my cat here for an emergency because she was drooling and had her tongue out. When we got there they put my cat on the table . We specifically told them it has to be her teeth. The man said “ Usually when cats do this it doesn’t mean it’s a tooth infection it’s something more serious “ He didn’t open her mouth or even check her he just said “I need to do several blood work and x rays to know what’s wrong with her. I will make a quick estimate for you”. I was so confused because he didn’t even bother to check her teeth. 10 mins passed and  they said it would be almost 2k to do all the tests and find the underlying issue. I was so upset because we told them it has to be her teeth they literally looked so annoyed and said we can’t know that for sure I’m like you didn’t even open her mouth!!!?? She then said if we don’t do this today that my cat might not make it through the morning. I literally told them this is ridiculous I just wanted you to ease her pain before I take her to our vet in the morning they all looked visibly upset when I said I’m taking my cat with me . They again  reminded that she wouldn’t make it if I took her home with me. Well good thing  I followed my gut instinct and took my cat home with me. The next morning I took her to my vet and  guess what ?? It turns out she did not have a fatal illness like they said she probably had .  I was right and it was her teeth!!!!. At my vet he Immediately saw her and he opened her mouth and said yep she has swollen gums. They extracted 2 of her teeth and gave her antibiotics. She’s eating, drinking and stopped drooling immediately after I took her to my vet. She’s doing really well now. I told my vet about this place and he said that I should report them becuase to any Vet it would be easily noticeable that it was from oral pain. If they would have opened her mouth they would have immediately saw that.  The fact that this place didn’t even check her and wanted me to pay 2k and told me my cat wouldn’t make it through the night is horrible. I can’t even imagine how many times they have used this scare tactic to scare customers so they’ll pay the ridiculous costs. My vet charged me $317 for everything and my cat left feeling so much better. This clinic charged me $300 just for them not to do anything!!!!. Absolutely Ridiculous!
